headline: The 702 current diagnostics are 700 honest fixture/helper contract-debt diagnostics and 2 validator false positives, but the strict validator is not migration-ready because broad route maps remain an unnamed false-clean bypass and recursive DeepPartial admits empty object placeholders.

currentEvidence.note: The source mtime postdated the manifest source log, so the compiler run was repeated against current source. The count remained 702.

parts.kind: erased helper provenance or overly broad helper boundaries
parts.judgment: Honest #2533 debt. unknown, Record<string, unknown>, unknown arrays, and TrpcRoutes override parameters erase the procedure-specific contract. Repair at the helper boundary; do not relax routeTrpc.

Honest debt. Includes ok-shaped sentinels, empty values for non-empty response contracts, and void mutations represented as objects. Values must be adjudicated against test behavior; blind replacement is forbidden.

The label is wrong. The bucket is contract debt: 37 preset.list responders return PresetDetailFixture arrays with fields that list cannot emit; 29 are whole-route/bundle diagnostics; 7 are settings response mismatches including SettingsWire.config typed unknown.

Honest stale or deliberately noncanonical fixtures after subtracting the two dictionary false positives. Null/undefined, wrong enum literals, legacy output names, query/mutation machinery cases, and computed procedure keys require intent review.

validatorFalsePositives.cause: ExactObject rejects every actual string index signature via `string extends keyof TActual ? never`, even when the AppRouter output itself is a string-indexed dictionary.
validatorFalsePositives.reproduction: /tmp/world-tools-route-trpc-false-clean-probe.json plus the later in-memory probe that reports the dictionary row

referencedOrigins.resolutionArtifact: Three rows resolve through Array.prototype.at in lib.es2022.array.d.ts and need local caller tracing.

broadHelperAnalysis.conclusion: Repairing 40 reused local helper declarations can retire 200 existing broad rows without editing those 200 call sites. Repairing all 85 referenced local declarations addresses 245 existing rows. It cannot collapse all 431: 183 rows are inline and three need caller tracing. A helper annotation may reveal a deeper shape mismatch, so these are exact current-row coverage counts, not a promise that total compiler diagnostics fall by the same amount.

broadMapBypass.evidence: routeTrpc(page, broadRecord), routeTrpc(page, legacyTrpcRoutes), defineTrpcRoutes(broadRecord), and defineTrpcRoutes(legacyTrpcRoutes) all produce zero diagnostics in the in-memory current-code probe.
broadMapBypass.cause: ExactRoutes returns unknown when string extends keyof TRoutes, and the exported non-procedure TrpcResponder/TrpcRoutes compatibility shapes carry unknown values.
broadMapBypass.judgment: This is an unnamed bypass and violates #2533. Keep only malformedOrForwardTrpcWire as the explicit escape.

deepPartial.evidence: Current code accepts databank.bankHealth: {} and worldInfo.listBooks: [{}].
deepPartial.judgment:
Recursive optionality is useful for focused fixtures, but allowing a zero-key object at every object node makes blind placeholders type-correct and defeats provenance. Require at least one canonical key for object fixtures (including array object elements), while preserving genuinely empty arrays. Full named canonical fixtures should use TrpcWireOutput

.

brandedScalars.judgment: Sound for this boundary. TrpcWire erases Branded<string> recursively and the permanent assets.listOwned control proves plain wire strings are accepted.

arrays.judgment: Empty arrays are valid canonical list outputs and must remain accepted. Nonempty elements should retain exact canonical-key checks. The current DeepPartial rule is too weak for [{}].

promises.judgment: Rejecting Promise responders is correct. routeTrpc does not await ordinary responders; a Promise would serialize incorrectly. trpcHold is the named deferred mechanism. No Promise diagnostic exists in the 702-row set.

functions.judgment: Synchronous responders and zero-argument responders are valid. The input check correctly accepts broad unknown parameters and rejects narrower incompatible parameters. Output checks must be identical to static output checks.

dictionaryOutputs.judgment: Repair centrally. ExactObject must distinguish an unauthorized broad index signature from a canonical AppRouter dictionary output. The current unconditional string-index rejection causes the two confirmed false positives.

queryMachinery.judgment: Tests of retry, optimistic cache, refusal-as-data, or boundary behavior do not get an unnamed route bypass. If their subject deliberately requires wire data the selected AppRouter procedure cannot emit, wrap only that response with malformedOrForwardTrpcWire and state the malformed/forward purpose. Otherwise repair the fixture to the current procedure contract.

phasedRecommendation.name: repair validator before migration
actions: Remove broad Record<string, unknown>/TrpcRoutes acceptance from ordinary routeTrpc and defineTrpcRoutes.
Add permanent negative controls for a broad route variable and a broad map passed through defineTrpcRoutes.
Allow canonical dictionary outputs while retaining rejection of broad records for fixed-shape outputs.
Replace zero-key DeepPartial with a nonempty canonical subset rule; retain empty arrays.
Add controls for {}, [{}], canonical dictionary output, Promise responder rejection, branded nested scalars, and the named malformed/forward escape.
phasedRecommendation.expectedDenominator: Must be rederived. Closing the current broad-map false-clean can reveal diagnostics absent from the 702-row manifest; no honest exact total exists before this rerun.

phasedRecommendation.name: repair reused procedure-specific helpers
phasedRecommendation.actions:
Use Code Mod Kit only after a closed origin-to-procedure map. Add/import TrpcResponder

or TrpcWireOutput

at 40 reused local declarations; preserve values and behavior.
phasedRecommendation.frozenManifestProjection: 702 - 2 validator false positives - 200 current rows = 500 current row IDs remaining.
phasedRecommendation.warning: A boundary repair can expose deeper field drift, so rerun and regenerate the manifest; do not claim 500 compiler diagnostics without that receipt.

phasedRecommendation.name: repair remaining helper boundaries
phasedRecommendation.actions: Handle 45 single-use referenced local declarations, then manually trace the three Array.at-attributed rows.

phasedRecommendation.name: inline broad responders
phasedRecommendation.actions: Adjudicate 183 inline broad values. Code Mod Kit may apply a reviewed, procedure-specific type insertion or already-decided syntax rewrite; it must not invent payloads.

phasedRecommendation.name: named and bundled contract drift
phasedRecommendation.actions: Repair 37 preset.list detail-as-summary rows, 29 bundle/whole-object rows, and 7 settings rows. Preserve named fixtures and split list summaries from detail fixtures.

phasedRecommendation.name: placeholder adjudication
phasedRecommendation.actions: Review all 81 against the consumer. Void/null changes, ok sentinels, list empties, and mutation echoes need behavior-aware decisions. Use Code Mod Kit only to apply an approved closed transform set.

phasedRecommendation.name: manual behavior-sensitive tail
phasedRecommendation.actions: Repair or explicitly escape the remaining 115. Every malformedOrForwardTrpcWire use must name why impossible current wire data is the test subject.
phasedRecommendation.frozenManifestProjection: 115 - 115 = 0 current row IDs remaining, followed by full manifest regeneration and duplicate/unclassified reconciliation.

allowed: closed imports and procedure-specific type annotations
mechanical application of a previously adjudicated exact payload transform
renaming/splitting a fixture only when the target declarations and call sites are closed and behavior-preserving
forbidden: replace every failure with {} or null
insert an unnamed cast, unknown, any, Record<string, unknown>, or broad TrpcRoutes escape
invent canonical payload values from type shape without reading the test behavior

behavioralVerificationGroups: routeTrpc type controls: direct static/function bad fields, wrong input, broad variable refusal, dictionary output, empty-object refusal, array-element refusal, Promise refusal, branded scalars, named escape
chat/query machinery: query-boundary, query-error-state, create-entity-mutation, composer, swipe, message actions
shared helper consumers: chat fixtures across seven files, use-orb-socket, discovery corpus paging/search, workloads jobs/schedules
settings/config and app shell: full default settings, override route bundles, ambient route helpers
preset: editor detail/get versus list summary behavior
plugin, notifications, persona, roster, refinery, world-info, user-admin feature CT files changed in each batch
after each batch: current tsconfig.tests-dom typecheck and regenerated closed manifest; final: route type controls, all affected CTs, Biome, ESLint

workItemRecommendation.parent: #2533 retains validator semantics, permanent controls, named escape policy, and final acceptance
workItemRecommendation.child: Own the 130-file fixture/helper migration against a regenerated post-validator manifest, with the phased row ledger and feature CT groups above.
workItemRecommendation.reason: The validator has blocking design defects and the migration has 700 honest debt diagnostics across 130 files. Combining both obscures whether a falling count came from stronger fixture provenance or a weaker validator. The parent remains incomplete until the child returns zero current diagnostics and no unnamed bypass.
